name: Ines
description: Waterkeeper. Thirty years on the Drownworks pump crews; foreperson at Pump House Nine. Straight, slow to trust, hard to move.
tagline: Pump-crew foreperson, Drownworks. Clean water or nothing.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Thirty years on the pumps. Never late on a shift.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Touches her brass disc while she decides about you.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Speaks for a crew. Threaten the water, the Works answers.

knows.mother-rot: Ines Calder. Night-crew foreperson at a Drownworks pump house; a Waterkeeper. She turned your man away at the Works gate in front of her whole crew, and she sends your new-year crate back every year. You'd give a great deal to hear her call you clean water.

standing.want: That you keep your word, small things included. Clean water first; everything else after.
standing.secret: During the second strike you kept the water running to the co-op clinics for three nights: a bypass you opened yourself, no crew vote, nobody told. Nobody ever found out.
standing.hint: who kept the clinics’ water on during the second strike
